subject.title: [Android] camera.snap missing, location.get not implemented, canvas.present broken on v2026.6.11

question: Should Android follow-up preserve the current in-app setting, node approval, and `gateway.nodes.allowCommands` gates while fixing diagnostics/advertisement/A2UI readiness, or intentionally broaden the Android command exposure contract?
rationale: Camera and location expose sensitive device data, and the current source shows both implemented commands and explicit authorization gates; automation should not decide that boundary from this report alone.

options.title: Verify and preserve gates
options.body: Run current-main Android proof and fix only the reproduced advertisement, reapproval, settings, or A2UI readiness defects while keeping sensitive command gates intact.

options.title: Broaden command exposure
options.body: Intentionally change Android command exposure only with explicit security/product approval, docs updates, and upgrade proof for existing users.

options.title: Split by proven cause
options.body: If live proof shows independent command-surface and A2UI failures, split the work into smaller owner-reviewed fixes.

recommendation.title: Verify and preserve gates
recommendation.body: Run current-main Android proof and fix only the reproduced advertisement, reapproval, settings, or A2UI readiness defects while keeping sensitive command gates intact.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily Android app behavior and command exposure, and `apps/android/README.md` names @obviyus as the Android app maintainer.
